question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 A 组：墨西哥 vs 韩国（90 分钟赛果）？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group A: Mexico vs Korea Republic (90-minute result)?
one_liner_cn: 主场作战的墨西哥实力与状态俱占优，约六成胜率看好取胜；韩国伤病隐忧下更依赖孙兴慜的个人发挥。
one_liner_en: Playing at home with a clear Elo and form edge, Mexico are favored at roughly 62%; injury-hit Korea lean heavily on Son Heung-min.

key_reasons.cn: 墨西哥 Elo 1875（第 18）对韩国 1758（第 33），且小组赛全程本土作战享主办国主场加成，本场在瓜达拉哈拉 Estadio Akron 进行。
key_reasons.en: Mexico's Elo of 1875 (rank 18) tops Korea's 1758 (rank 33), and as co-hosts Mexico play all group matches at home, this one at Estadio Akron in Guadalajara.

key_reasons.cn: 韩国核心球员存在伤病与状态隐忧，中场核心黄仁范带脚踝伤入选名单。
key_reasons.en: Korea's core carries injury and form concerns; key midfielder Hwang In-beom made the squad while nursing an ankle injury.

key_reasons.cn: 墨西哥锋线支点劳尔·希门尼斯 2025-26 赛季为富勒姆打进 9 粒联赛进球，携良好状态领衔主场攻击线。
key_reasons.en: Mexico's focal point Raul Jimenez arrives in form, with 9 league goals for Fulham in 2025-26 leading the home attack.

method_note: Market-blind: three-way Davidson Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, +100 host bonus for Mexico group match) gave 60.2/22.6/17.3; bounded evidence adjustment of +2pp Mexico / -2pp Korea (cap ±8pp) for Korean injury/form concerns vs in-form Mexico; renormalized. No betting or prediction-market inputs of any kind.
